1) our proposed competitive pooling module is an effective alternative to the collaborative pooling module; and 2), the competitive pooling module, when used in a ConvNet, can improve classification accuracy on a variety of image classification problems.

the use of maxout units in the inception module promotes competition amongst the multiple size convolutional filters, thus preventing filter co-adaptations.

the competitive pooling stage of our proposed module can be used as an alternative to the traditional concatenation stage in the inception module.
